question: Integrate WES and RNA-Seq data to annotate all pathogenic variants with an expression status. For each pathogenic variant, report whether its gene is expressed (TPM > 1.0 in any sample).

expected_output.description: rows as pathogenic variants, columns should include Gene, Chrom, Pos, VariantID, REF, ALT, ClinSig, Expressed (boolean: True if gene TPM > 1.0 in any sample, False otherwise)
